words.enDefinition: Study of body structures visible without using a microscope

examples.en: Our gross anatomy class compares the visible shapes of organs on teaching models.
examples.zh: 我们的「大体解剖学」课用教学模型比较器官可见的外形。

examples.en: We used a gross anatomy atlas to label structures visible to the unaided eye.
examples.zh: 我们用「大体解剖学」图谱给肉眼可见的结构加上标注。

words.enDefinition: Study of body structures that require magnification for detailed examination

examples.en: The microscopic anatomy lecture uses enlarged images of structures smaller than we can see.
examples.zh: 「显微解剖学」课堂使用肉眼难以辨清的微小结构的放大图像。

examples.en: We compared microscopic anatomy images with the larger structures shown on the model.
examples.zh: 我们把「显微解剖学」图像与模型上较大的结构作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Study of the microscopic structure and organization of biological tissues

examples.en: Our histology class identifies tissue types by the arrangement of their cells.
examples.zh: 我们的「组织学」课通过细胞排列方式辨认组织类型。

examples.en: The histology atlas shows what several human tissues look like when magnified.
examples.zh: 「组织学」图谱展示多种人体组织放大后的样子。

words.enDefinition: Study of body structures grouped together within a specified physical region

examples.en: In regional anatomy, we studied several different structures found within the same body region.
examples.zh: 在「局部解剖学」课上，我们学习了人体同一区域内的多种结构。

examples.en: The regional anatomy diagram brings together the layers and structures of the neck.
examples.zh: 「局部解剖学」示意图把颈部的层次和结构集中画出。

words.enDefinition: Study of body structures organized by the organ systems they belong to

examples.en: The systemic anatomy chapter groups structures by the body system they belong to.
examples.zh: 「系统解剖学」这一章按各结构所属的人体系统将它们分组。

examples.en: We used systemic anatomy to follow one system across several different body regions.
examples.zh: 我们通过「系统解剖学」追踪一个系统在多个不同体区的分布。

words.enDefinition: Study of external features and their relationships to structures beneath them

examples.en: The surface anatomy drawing identifies the visible outlines on the front of the model.
examples.zh: 「体表解剖学」图标出了模型前面可见的外形轮廓。

examples.en: We used surface anatomy to relate a visible ridge to the structure underneath.
examples.zh: 我们用「体表解剖学」把可见的隆起与其下方的结构联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Upright reference posture with feet and palms forward and arms at sides

examples.en: The chart places the model in anatomical position with both palms facing forward.
examples.zh: 图表中的模型采用双掌朝前的「解剖学姿势」。

examples.en: Directional labels use anatomical position even when the model itself is lying down.
examples.zh: 即使模型本身平躺，方位标注仍以「解剖学姿势」为参照。

words.enDefinition: Recognizable bodily feature used to describe the location of nearby structures

examples.en: We used a visible notch as an anatomical landmark on the body model.
examples.zh: 我们把人体模型上的一个可见切迹用作「解剖标志」。

examples.en: The diagram marks an anatomical landmark before locating the smaller structure beside it.
examples.zh: 示意图先标出一个「解剖标志」，再定位它旁边较小的结构。

words.enDefinition: Difference in bodily structure among individuals within the range being described

examples.en: The atlas illustrates anatomical variation by showing two common versions of one structure.
examples.zh: 图谱展示同一结构的两种常见形态，以说明「解剖变异」。

examples.en: Our lecturer discussed anatomical variation before comparing the outlines in two teaching images.
examples.zh: 老师在比较两张教学图像中的轮廓之前，讨论了「解剖变异」。

words.enDefinition: Imaginary line marking the middle of the body in the reference position

examples.en: The dashed anatomical midline runs down the exact center of the front view.
examples.zh: 虚线所示的「人体正中线」沿正视图的中央向下延伸。

examples.en: We used the anatomical midline as a reference for comparing right and left.
examples.zh: 我们以「人体正中线」为参照比较人体的左侧和右侧。

words.enDefinition: Located closer to the front of the human body than another structure

examples.en: The chest wall is anterior to the heart in the side view of the model.
examples.zh: 在模型的侧视图里，胸壁位于心脏「前方」。

examples.en: In the diagram, the nose is anterior to the ear on the same side.
examples.zh: 图中鼻子位于同侧耳朵的「前方」。

words.enDefinition: Located closer to the back of the human body than another structure

examples.en: The model places the spine posterior to the heart when viewed from the side.
examples.zh: 从侧面观察，模型中的脊柱位于心脏「后方」。

examples.en: The ear lies posterior to the outer corner of the eye in this drawing.
examples.zh: 在这幅图里，耳朵位于眼外角「后方」。

words.enDefinition: Located closer to the head than another structure in the reference position

examples.en: The eyes are superior to the mouth in the model's front view.
examples.zh: 在模型的正视图中，双眼位于口部「上方」。

examples.en: We labeled the chest as superior to the abdomen on the upright figure.
examples.zh: 我们在直立人体图中标明，胸部位于腹部「上方」。

words.enDefinition: Located closer to the feet than another structure in the reference position

examples.en: The mouth is inferior to the nose in the figure we labeled.
examples.zh: 我们标注的人体图中，口部位于鼻子「下方」。

examples.en: The abdomen lies inferior to the chest even when the body model is horizontal.
examples.zh: 即使人体模型横放，解剖方位上的腹部仍位于胸部「下方」。

words.enDefinition: Located closer to the body's midline than the referenced structure

examples.en: The nose lies medial to either eye in the front anatomical view.
examples.zh: 在解剖正视图中，鼻子位于任一眼睛的「内侧」。

examples.en: The worksheet asks which of the two labels is medial to the eye.
examples.zh: 习题问，两个标注中哪一个位于眼睛「内侧」。

words.enDefinition: Located farther from the body's midline than the referenced structure

examples.en: The shoulders lie lateral to the neck in the front view of the model.
examples.zh: 在模型的正视图里，肩部位于颈部「外侧」。

examples.en: We marked a point lateral to the nose near the outer cheek.
examples.zh: 我们在靠近脸颊外缘、位于鼻子「外侧」的位置标了一点。

words.enDefinition: Located nearer a limb's attachment or another specified point of origin

examples.en: The diagram places the elbow proximal to the wrist along the upper limb.
examples.zh: 图中显示，在同一条上肢上，肘部「比腕部更近躯干」。

examples.en: We marked the upper point as proximal to the lower point on the forearm.
examples.zh: 对于前臂上的两个点，我们标明上方一点「比下方一点更近躯干」。

words.enDefinition: Located farther from a limb's attachment or another specified point of origin

examples.en: The wrist is distal to the elbow in the standard diagram of the arm.
examples.zh: 在手臂的标准示意图中，腕部「比肘部更远离躯干」。

examples.en: The guide labels the fingertips as distal to the knuckles on our hand model.
examples.zh: 指南在手部模型上标明，指尖「比指关节更远离躯干」。

words.enDefinition: Located nearer the external surface of the body than another structure

examples.en: The skin is superficial to the muscle layer in our model of the arm.
examples.zh: 在手臂模型中，皮肤「比肌层更靠近体表」。

examples.en: In the diagram, the thin covering lies superficial to the colored tissue layer.
examples.zh: 在图中，薄薄的覆盖层「比带颜色的组织层更靠近体表」。

words.enDefinition: Located farther from the external surface of the body than another structure

examples.en: The ribs are deep to the skin in the cutaway view of the chest.
examples.zh: 在胸部剖视图中，肋骨「比皮肤更远离体表」。

examples.en: We placed the darker layer deep to the light covering in the teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把较深色的一层画在「比浅色覆盖层更远离体表」的位置。

words.enDefinition: Situated on the same side of the body as another structure

examples.en: The right arm and right leg are ipsilateral in the reference illustration.
examples.zh: 在参照图中，右臂和右腿位于「同侧」。

examples.en: We grouped the two marks as ipsilateral because both appear on the left.
examples.zh: 由于两个标记都在左侧，我们把它们归为「同侧」。

words.enDefinition: Situated on the opposite side of the body from another structure

examples.en: The left hand is contralateral to the right foot in this diagram.
examples.zh: 在此图中，左手位于右脚的「对侧」。

examples.en: Our exercise pairs each marked shoulder with the contralateral side of the model.
examples.zh: 习题将每个有标记的肩部与模型的「对侧」配成一对。

words.enDefinition: Present or described on both the right and left sides

examples.en: The drawing shows a bilateral arrangement with a matching component on each side.
examples.zh: 该图显示了左右两侧都有相应组成部分的「双侧」排列。

examples.en: We added bilateral labels for structures shown on both sides of the body.
examples.zh: 我们给图中在人体左右两边都出现的结构加上了「双侧」标注。

words.enDefinition: Present or described on only one side of the body

examples.en: The worksheet uses a unilateral view showing the left arm by itself.
examples.zh: 习题用一幅只显示左臂的「单侧」图。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a unilateral mark on the right side of the model.
examples.zh: 老师在模型右侧画了一个「单侧」标记。

words.enDefinition: Surface facing the front of the human trunk

examples.en: We colored the ventral surface on the front of the torso model.
examples.zh: 我们给躯干模型前面的「腹侧面」涂上了颜色。

examples.en: The diagram shows the ventral surface from the chest down to the abdomen.
examples.zh: 示意图展示了从胸部到腹部的「腹侧面」。

words.enDefinition: Surface facing the back of the human trunk

examples.en: The back view of the torso shows its dorsal surface in the atlas.
examples.zh: 图谱中的躯干背面视图展示了它的「背侧面」。

examples.en: The worksheet shades the dorsal surface of the trunk around the spinal column.
examples.zh: 习题将脊柱周围的躯干「背侧面」绘为阴影区域。

words.enDefinition: Front surface of the hand in the standard reference position

examples.en: The hand model shows the palmar surface with the fingers pointing downward.
examples.zh: 手部模型的手指朝下，显示的是「手掌面」。

examples.en: We colored the palmar surface on the same side as the palm creases.
examples.zh: 我们给与掌纹同一侧的「手掌面」涂上了颜色。

words.enDefinition: Back surface of the hand opposite its palm in anatomical position

examples.en: The dorsum of the hand faces away from the palm in the reference hand model.
examples.zh: 在参照手部模型中，「手背」朝向与手掌相反。

examples.en: We placed a different color on the dorsum of the hand in the class drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中用不同颜色标出了「手背」。

collocations: label the dorsum of the hand
view the dorsum of the hand
skin on the dorsum of the hand

words.enDefinition: Lower surface of the foot that faces the ground when standing

examples.en: The plantar surface appears on the underside of the foot model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂足部模型的底面显示了「足底面」。

examples.en: We marked the plantar surface beneath the toes and heel in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中标出了脚趾和足跟下方的「足底面」。

words.enDefinition: Upper surface of the foot opposite the sole in anatomical position

examples.en: The dorsum of the foot is visible when looking down at the upright model's toes.
examples.zh: 向下看直立模型的脚趾时，可以看见「足背」。

examples.en: We used an arrow to label the dorsum of the foot in the side view.
examples.zh: 我们在侧视图中用箭头标出了「足背」。

collocations: label the dorsum of the foot
view the dorsum of the foot
skin on the dorsum of the foot

words.enDefinition: Body position lying horizontally with the front of the trunk facing downward

examples.en: The figure in prone position faces downward on the horizontal reference surface.
examples.zh: 处于「俯卧位」的人体图在水平参照面上面朝下方。

examples.en: We labeled the back of the model while it was in prone position.
examples.zh: 模型处于「俯卧位」时，我们标出了它的背部。

words.enDefinition: Body position lying horizontally with the front of the trunk facing upward

examples.en: The figure in supine position lies on its back with the face upward.
examples.zh: 处于「仰卧位」的人体图躺在背上，脸朝上方。

examples.en: The drawing shows supine position beside a model lying on its side.
examples.zh: 这幅图在侧卧模型旁边画出了「仰卧位」。

words.enDefinition: Body position lying horizontally on either the left or the right side

examples.en: Our atlas shows a lateral recumbent position with the model resting on its left side.
examples.zh: 我们的图谱展示了模型靠左侧躺卧的「侧卧位」。

examples.en: We labeled the lateral recumbent position on the figure that faces across the page.
examples.zh: 我们在面朝页面侧方的人体图上标出了「侧卧位」。

collocations: model in the lateral recumbent position

words.enDefinition: Imaginary flat surface used to describe a division through the body

examples.en: The transparent anatomical plane crosses the model from its front to its back.
examples.zh: 透明的「解剖平面」从模型前面穿到后面。

examples.en: We chose an anatomical plane before describing which structures appeared in the section.
examples.zh: 描述切面中出现哪些结构之前，我们先选定了一个「解剖平面」。

words.enDefinition: Vertical plane dividing the body into left and right portions

examples.en: A sagittal plane divides the model into a left portion and a right portion.
examples.zh: 「矢状面」把模型分成左部和右部。

examples.en: Our sagittal plane is drawn slightly to the left of the body's center.
examples.zh: 图中的「矢状面」画在人体正中线稍偏左的位置。

words.enDefinition: Vertical plane passing through the midline between equal left and right portions

examples.en: The midsagittal plane passes through the center of the nose on our model.
examples.zh: 我们模型中的「正中矢状面」穿过鼻子的中央。

examples.en: We drew the midsagittal plane to divide the body into right and left halves.
examples.zh: 我们画出「正中矢状面」，将人体分成左、右两半。

words.enDefinition: Plane parallel to the midsagittal plane but offset from the midline

examples.en: The parasagittal plane runs parallel to the center plane a little to its left.
examples.zh: 「旁矢状面」与正中平面平行，位于稍偏左的位置。

examples.en: We used a parasagittal plane to show structures away from the exact center.
examples.zh: 我们用「旁矢状面」显示偏离正中央的结构。

words.enDefinition: Vertical plane dividing the body into anterior and posterior portions

examples.en: The frontal plane separates the front and back portions of the displayed model.
examples.zh: 「额状面」将展示模型分为前、后两部分。

examples.en: Our frontal plane is drawn upright and parallel to the model's front outline.
examples.zh: 图中的「额状面」为竖直平面，与模型的正面轮廓平行。

words.enDefinition: Plane dividing the upright body into upper and lower portions

examples.en: The transverse plane crosses the standing model horizontally through the level of its waist.
examples.zh: 「横断面」在腰部高度水平穿过直立模型。

examples.en: We drew a transverse plane to compare the structures above and below it.
examples.zh: 我们画出一个「横断面」，比较它上方与下方的结构。

words.enDefinition: Plane passing diagonally relative to the standard horizontal or vertical planes

examples.en: The oblique plane crosses the model at an angle to the horizontal line.
examples.zh: 「斜切面」与水平线成一定角度，穿过模型。

examples.en: We labeled the tilted plane in the atlas as an oblique plane.
examples.zh: 我们将图谱中倾斜的平面标为「斜切面」。

words.enDefinition: View or slice taken along the length of a body structure

examples.en: The longitudinal section shows the long axis of the tubular structure in our sketch.
examples.zh: 草图中的「纵切面」显示该管状结构的长轴。

examples.en: Parallel lines run along the longitudinal section of the model's long fibers.
examples.zh: 在模型长纤维的「纵切面」中，纤维呈平行线排列。

words.enDefinition: Slice showing structures across the long axis of a body part

examples.en: The anatomical cross section shows rings in a structure that looks long from the side.
examples.zh: 从侧面看很长的结构，在其「解剖横截面」上呈现环形。

examples.en: We compared an anatomical cross section with another view drawn along the structure's length.
examples.zh: 我们将「解剖横截面」与沿结构纵向绘制的另一幅图作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Central body region comprising the head, neck, and trunk

examples.en: The atlas shades the axial region from the head down through the trunk.
examples.zh: 图谱用阴影标出从头部向下贯穿躯干的「中轴部」。

examples.en: We marked the axial region before identifying the parts extending from the trunk.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「中轴部」，再识别从躯干伸出的部分。

words.enDefinition: Body region consisting of the upper and lower limbs

examples.en: The appendicular region includes the arms and legs in the colored model.
examples.zh: 在彩色模型中，「附肢部」包括双臂和双腿。

examples.en: We used a separate color for the appendicular region on both sides.
examples.zh: 我们用另一种颜色标出了人体两侧的「附肢部」。

words.enDefinition: Body region occupied by the neck between the head and trunk

examples.en: The label for the cervical region points to the neck on the model.
examples.zh: 「颈区」的标注指向模型的颈部。

examples.en: Our side view shows the cervical region between the head and upper chest.
examples.zh: 侧视图显示了位于头部与上胸部之间的「颈区」。

words.enDefinition: Area of the lower back between the ribs and pelvis

examples.en: We shaded the lumbar region on the back below the lower ribs.
examples.zh: 我们给背部较低肋骨以下的「腰区」涂上了阴影。

examples.en: The lumbar region appears above the pelvis in the atlas's rear view.
examples.zh: 在图谱的后视图中，「腰区」位于骨盆上方。

words.enDefinition: Area at the front of the elbow where the arm bends

examples.en: The antecubital region is marked where the elbow bends in the front view.
examples.zh: 正视图中，肘部弯曲处被标为「肘前区」。

examples.en: We labeled the antecubital region before turning the arm model to show its back.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「肘前区」，再转动手臂模型展示其背面。

collocations: anterior view of the antecubital region

words.enDefinition: Area behind the knee between the back of the thigh and calf

examples.en: In the rear view, the popliteal region lies directly behind the knee joint.
examples.zh: 在后视图中，「膝后区」就在膝关节后方。

examples.en: We marked the popliteal region on the back of the bent leg model.
examples.zh: 我们在弯曲的腿部模型背面标出了「膝后区」。

collocations: posterior view of the popliteal region

words.enDefinition: Rank within the hierarchy from smaller components to more complex bodily units

examples.en: Each level of structural organization in the chart combines parts from the level below it.
examples.zh: 图表中的每个「结构层次」都由下一个较低层次的部分组合而成。

examples.en: We identified the level of structural organization represented by the collection of tissues in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们辨认了图中这些组织聚集起来所代表的「结构层次」。

collocations: identify a level of structural organization

words.enDefinition: Organizational level where cells and surrounding material perform shared functions

examples.en: At the tissue level, the diagram groups similar cells by their shared role.
examples.zh: 在「组织层次」，示意图按共同作用给相似细胞分组。

examples.en: We used the tissue level diagram to show cells and material between them.
examples.zh: 我们用「组织层次」示意图展示细胞和它们之间的物质。

words.enDefinition: Organizational level where multiple tissue types form a structure with specialized functions

examples.en: The organ level diagram shows several different tissues contributing to one distinct structure.
examples.zh: 「器官层次」示意图显示多种不同组织共同构成一个独立结构。

examples.en: We moved from the tissue examples to the organ level during the lecture.
examples.zh: 课堂从组织的例子过渡到了「器官层次」。

words.enDefinition: Group of organs working together to perform major bodily functions

examples.en: The diagram groups several connected organs into one organ system for the lesson.
examples.zh: 教学示意图把几个彼此相连的器官归入同一个「器官系统」。

examples.en: We traced the organ system across several regions on the whole body model.
examples.zh: 我们在全身模型上查看了该「器官系统」在多个体区的分布。

words.enDefinition: Internal compartment in the body that contains or surrounds an anatomical structure

examples.en: We shaded each body cavity in the cutaway drawing of the torso.
examples.zh: 我们在躯干剖视图中给每个「体腔」涂上了阴影。

examples.en: The tutor asked which body cavity contained the highlighted structure in the diagram.
examples.zh: 老师问，图中高亮结构位于哪个「体腔」。

words.enDefinition: Posterior compartment encompassing the spaces for the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The dorsal body cavity includes a compartment in the skull and one along the spine.
examples.zh: 「背侧体腔」包括颅骨内的一个腔和沿脊柱延伸的一个腔。

examples.en: We marked the dorsal body cavity in blue on the model's side view.
examples.zh: 我们在模型侧视图中用蓝色标出了「背侧体腔」。

collocations: subdivisions of the dorsal body cavity
contents of the dorsal body cavity

words.enDefinition: Large anterior compartment divided into the thoracic and abdominopelvic cavities

examples.en: The ventral body cavity extends from the chest down into the pelvic region.
examples.zh: 「腹侧体腔」从胸部向下延伸到骨盆区域。

examples.en: We drew the diaphragm across the ventral body cavity to show its major subdivisions.
examples.zh: 我们在「腹侧体腔」中画出横隔，表示它的主要分区。

collocations: subdivisions of the ventral body cavity
organs in the ventral body cavity

words.enDefinition: Space within the skull containing the brain and its surrounding coverings

examples.en: The cranial cavity is highlighted inside the skull in our section diagram.
examples.zh: 在我们的剖面图中，颅骨内部的「颅腔」被高亮标出。

examples.en: The tutor outlined the cranial cavity before showing the structures it contains.
examples.zh: 老师先勾勒「颅腔」的轮廓，再展示里面的结构。

words.enDefinition: Continuous passage within the vertebral column that contains the spinal cord

examples.en: We traced the vertebral canal down the spine on the sagittal diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在矢状面示意图上沿脊柱向下描画「椎管」。

examples.en: The vertebral canal connects with the space inside the skull in the model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「椎管」与颅骨内的空间相通。

words.enDefinition: Internal compartment of the chest above the diaphragm containing the lungs and mediastinum

examples.en: The thoracic cavity lies above the diaphragm in the trunk model's side view.
examples.zh: 躯干模型的侧视图中，「胸腔」位于横隔上方。

examples.en: Our diagram shows the lungs on either side of the center within the thoracic cavity.
examples.zh: 我们的示意图显示双肺位于「胸腔」内中央区域的两侧。

words.enDefinition: Combined abdominal and pelvic compartment below the diaphragm in the trunk

examples.en: The abdominopelvic cavity includes the spaces shown in both lower sections of the diagram.
examples.zh: 「腹盆腔」包括图中下方两部分所示的空间。

examples.en: We shaded the abdominopelvic cavity below the diaphragm on the same trunk model.
examples.zh: 我们在同一个躯干模型上给横隔以下的「腹盆腔」涂上阴影。

words.enDefinition: Upper portion of the abdominopelvic cavity situated below the diaphragm

examples.en: The abdominal cavity occupies the upper part of the model's abdominopelvic space.
examples.zh: 「腹腔」占据模型中腹盆腔的上部。

examples.en: The diagram outlines the abdominal cavity separately from the smaller space farther down.
examples.zh: 示意图分别勾勒出「腹腔」和下方较小空间的轮廓。

collocations: upper part of the abdominal cavity

words.enDefinition: Lower trunk compartment enclosed by the bones and muscles of the pelvis

examples.en: We marked the bony outline around the pelvic cavity in the side view.
examples.zh: 我们在侧视图中标出了围绕「盆腔」的骨性轮廓。

words.enDefinition: Central region of the thorax located between the two pleural sacs

examples.en: The mediastinum is shaded between the two lung compartments in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中两个肺所处的腔隙之间用阴影表示「纵隔」。

examples.en: We located the mediastinum before identifying the heart within the chest diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先定位「纵隔」，再在胸部示意图里识别心脏。

words.enDefinition: Potential space between the two serous membrane layers surrounding each lung

examples.en: The textbook exaggerates the pleural cavity to show the two layers clearly.
examples.zh: 教材把「胸膜腔」画得较宽，以便清楚显示两层膜。

examples.en: Our diagram shows one pleural cavity on each side of the central chest region.
examples.zh: 图中胸部中央区域两侧各画出一个「胸膜腔」。

words.enDefinition: Potential space between the two layers of serous pericardium around the heart

examples.en: The pericardial cavity lies between two layers in the simplified heart drawing.
examples.zh: 在简化的心脏图中，「心包腔」位于两层膜之间。

examples.en: We marked the pericardial cavity beside the lining directly over the model's heart.
examples.zh: 我们在模型中紧贴心脏的膜旁标出了「心包腔」。

words.enDefinition: Potential space between layers of peritoneum within the abdominopelvic region

examples.en: The peritoneal cavity is shown as a thin space between two colored layers.
examples.zh: 「腹膜腔」被画成两层带颜色的膜之间的一道窄隙。

examples.en: The tutor marked the peritoneal cavity separately from the larger abdominal compartment.
examples.zh: 老师分别标出了「腹膜腔」和包含它的较大腹腔。

words.enDefinition: Thin membrane lining certain internal cavities and covering organs within them

examples.en: The diagram shows a serous membrane lining a wall and folding over an organ.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「浆膜」衬在腔壁上，并反折包覆一个器官。

examples.en: We colored both portions of the serous membrane in the teaching model.
examples.zh: 我们在教学模型中给「浆膜」的两部分都涂上了颜色。

words.enDefinition: Portion of a serous membrane that lines the surrounding cavity wall

examples.en: The parietal layer follows the cavity wall in the magnified textbook diagram.
examples.zh: 放大的教材图中，「壁层」沿着腔壁分布。

examples.en: We labeled the parietal layer at the boundary next to the body wall.
examples.zh: 我们在靠近体壁的边界标出了「壁层」。

collocations: parietal layer of a serous membrane
line the wall with the parietal layer

words.enDefinition: Portion of a serous membrane that lies directly on an organ

examples.en: The visceral layer follows the organ's outline closely in the colored figure.
examples.zh: 在彩色图中，「脏层」紧贴器官的外轮廓。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed to the visceral layer directly covering the model organ.
examples.zh: 老师指向直接覆盖模型器官的「脏层」。

collocations: visceral layer of a serous membrane

words.enDefinition: Thin lubricating liquid present between layers of a serous membrane

examples.en: The textbook shows serous fluid as a thin film between the membrane layers.
examples.zh: 教材把「浆液」画成两层膜之间的一层薄薄液体。

examples.en: We discussed how serous fluid reduces friction as the illustrated surfaces move.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了图示表面相对运动时，「浆液」怎样减少摩擦。

words.enDefinition: One of four abdominal areas defined by crossing vertical and horizontal lines

examples.en: We labeled each abdominal quadrant after drawing a cross centered on the navel.
examples.zh: 我们先以肚脐为中心画出十字线，再标出各「腹部象限」。

examples.en: The worksheet asks which abdominal quadrant contains the dot shown on the body outline.
examples.zh: 习题问，人体轮廓上的圆点位于哪个「腹部象限」。

examples.en: The right upper quadrant appears on our left when we face the model.

examples.en: We placed the arrow in the right upper quadrant above the model's navel.
examples.zh: 我们把箭头画在模型肚脐上方的「右上腹象限」内。

examples.en: The tutor marked the left upper quadrant using the model's own left side.
examples.zh: 老师以模型自身的左侧为准标出了「左上腹象限」。

collocations: left upper quadrant of the abdomen
model of the left upper quadrant

words.enDefinition: Abdominal quadrant below the navel on the body's right side

examples.en: The chart puts the right lower quadrant below the crossing at the navel.
examples.zh: 图表将「右下腹象限」画在肚脐处十字交点的下方。

examples.en: We located the right lower quadrant before checking the labels on the reverse side.
examples.zh: 我们先定位「右下腹象限」，再查看背页的标注。

words.enDefinition: Abdominal quadrant below the navel on the body's left side

examples.en: We shaded the left lower quadrant below the horizontal line on the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型的水平线下方给「左下腹象限」涂上了阴影。

words.enDefinition: Grid of three rows and three columns used to describe abdominal locations

examples.en: Our diagram of the nine abdominal regions has a square centered on the navel.
examples.zh: 我们的「腹部九区」图有一个以肚脐为中心的方格。

examples.en: We used the nine abdominal regions to label a position more specifically than a quadrant.
examples.zh: 相比四分法，我们用「腹部九区」更具体地标明一个位置。

words.enDefinition: Upper middle area of the abdomen in the nine-region scheme

examples.en: The epigastric region occupies the top middle box on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 「腹上区」占据课堂图表最上一排的中间方格。

examples.en: We marked the epigastric region directly above the box containing the navel.
examples.zh: 我们在含肚脐方格的正上方标出了「腹上区」。

words.enDefinition: Central area of the abdominal grid surrounding the navel

examples.en: The navel sits inside the umbilical region in the model's abdominal grid.
examples.zh: 在模型的腹部网格中，肚脐位于「脐区」以内。

examples.en: We labeled the umbilical region at the center of the chart's middle row.
examples.zh: 我们在图表中间一排的中央标出了「脐区」。

words.enDefinition: Lower middle area of the abdomen in the nine-region scheme

examples.en: The hypogastric region is the central box in the diagram's bottom row.
examples.zh: 「腹下区」是图中最下一排的中央方格。

examples.en: We marked the hypogastric region under the box that contains the navel.
examples.zh: 我们在含肚脐方格的下方标出了「腹下区」。

words.enDefinition: Either upper side area beneath the ribs in the abdominal grid

examples.en: We marked the right hypochondriac region beside the center of the top row.
examples.zh: 我们在最上一排中央方格的旁边标出了右「季肋区」。

examples.en: The upper corner of the grid represents a hypochondriac region in the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中网格上面的一角代表一个「季肋区」。

words.enDefinition: Either lower side area near the hip in the abdominal grid

examples.en: The left iliac region is at one end of the lowest row.
examples.zh: 左「髂区」位于最下一排的一端。

examples.en: We marked an iliac region beside the lower central box on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们在图表下方中央方格的旁边标出了一个「髂区」。

words.enDefinition: Either side area in the middle row of the abdominal grid

examples.en: We marked the left lateral abdominal region beside the center of the middle row.
examples.zh: 我们在中间一排中央方格的旁边标出了左「腹外侧区」。

examples.en: Each lateral abdominal region is directly beside the box that contains the navel.
examples.zh: 两个「腹外侧区」各位于含有肚脐的方格的一侧。

words.enDefinition: Sheets of closely arranged cells covering surfaces, lining spaces, or forming glands

examples.en: The diagram shows epithelial tissue covering the exposed surface of the example organ.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「上皮组织」覆盖在示例器官露出的表面。

examples.en: We identified the tightly packed layer as epithelial tissue in the atlas image.
examples.zh: 在图谱图像中，我们将细胞排列紧密的一层辨认为「上皮组织」。

words.enDefinition: Tissue whose cells and surrounding matrix support, link, or separate structures

examples.en: The atlas shows connective tissue below the dark surface layer in cross section.
examples.zh: 横截面图谱显示，深色表层下方是「结缔组织」。

examples.en: We recognized connective tissue by the visible material separating its cells in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们根据图中细胞之间可见的物质辨认出「结缔组织」。

words.enDefinition: Tissue composed of cells specialized to contract and generate force

examples.en: We compared three forms of muscle tissue using enlarged illustrations from the textbook.
examples.zh: 我们用教材里的放大图比较了三种「肌组织」。

examples.en: The muscle tissue model shows fibers arranged to produce force along their length.
examples.zh: 「肌组织」模型显示纤维排列成可沿其长度方向产生力的方式。

words.enDefinition: Tissue composed of neurons and supporting cells that process or transmit signals

examples.en: The nervous tissue illustration shows signal-carrying cells with long branches and nearby supporting cells.
examples.zh: 「神经组织」示意图显示了带长突起的传递信号细胞及旁边的支持细胞。

examples.en: We labeled nervous tissue in the model of the brain and spinal cord.
examples.zh: 我们在脑和脊髓模型上标出了「神经组织」。

words.enDefinition: Side of an epithelial cell facing a lumen or exposed space

examples.en: The apical surface faces the open space at the center of the tube.
examples.zh: 「顶端面」朝向管道中央的开放空间。

examples.en: We drew the apical surface along the side that faces the free space.
examples.zh: 我们沿朝向开放空间的一侧画出了「顶端面」。

words.enDefinition: Cell side facing the supporting layer beneath an epithelial sheet

examples.en: We labeled the basal surface where the epithelial cells meet the supporting layer.
examples.zh: 我们在上皮细胞与支撑层相接的位置标出了「基底面」。

examples.en: The figure shows the basal surface opposite the side facing the open space.
examples.zh: 图中「基底面」位于朝向开放空间的一面的对侧。

collocations: basal surface of an epithelial cell

words.enDefinition: Thin extracellular layer supporting and anchoring an overlying epithelial sheet

examples.en: The basement membrane appears as a thin boundary beneath the row of epithelial cells.
examples.zh: 「基底膜」在成排上皮细胞下方呈现为一条薄薄的边界。

examples.en: We traced the basement membrane between the epithelium and the underlying connective tissue.
examples.zh: 我们描出了位于上皮与下方结缔组织之间的「基底膜」。

words.enDefinition: Epithelial sheet composed of one layer of cells along the basement membrane

examples.en: The model shows simple epithelium as one continuous row of closely spaced cells.
examples.zh: 模型将「单层上皮」画成一排连续、排列紧密的细胞。

examples.en: We identified simple epithelium after seeing a single cell layer from base to surface.
examples.zh: 看到从基底到表面只有一层细胞后，我们辨认出这是「单层上皮」。

words.enDefinition: Epithelium with multiple cell layers, with basal cells attached to the basement membrane

examples.en: The drawing shows several stacked layers of stratified epithelium above the supporting membrane.
examples.zh: 图中支撑膜上方示出了由好几层细胞叠成的「复层上皮」。

examples.en: We focused on the surface cells to classify the stratified epithelium in the image.
examples.zh: 我们重点观察图中的表层细胞，以确定「复层上皮」的类型。

words.enDefinition: Flat epithelial cell whose width exceeds its height in side view

examples.en: The drawing shows a squamous epithelial cell as a thin shape with a flattened outline.
examples.zh: 图中将「鳞状上皮细胞」画成轮廓扁平的薄片状结构。

examples.en: We found a squamous epithelial cell near the exposed surface of the illustrated layer.
examples.zh: 我们在图示组织层朝外的表面附近找到了一个「鳞状上皮细胞」。

collocations: outline of a squamous epithelial cell

words.enDefinition: Epithelial cell approximately as tall as it is wide in section

examples.en: The cuboidal epithelial cell looks roughly square in the side view of the atlas.
examples.zh: 在图谱侧视图中，「立方上皮细胞」看起来近似方形。

examples.en: We measured the height and width of a cuboidal epithelial cell in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在图中量了一个「立方上皮细胞」的高度和宽度。

collocations: shape of a cuboidal epithelial cell

words.enDefinition: Tall epithelial cell whose height exceeds its width in side view

examples.en: A columnar epithelial cell is taller than it is wide in our labeled diagram.
examples.zh: 在我们标注的示意图中，「柱状上皮细胞」的高度大于宽度。

examples.en: The arrow points to one columnar epithelial cell in the row lining the tube.
examples.zh: 箭头指向管壁内衬那一排中的一个「柱状上皮细胞」。

collocations: shape of a columnar epithelial cell

words.enDefinition: Single layer of flattened epithelial cells, often forming a thin barrier

examples.en: The atlas shows simple squamous epithelium as a remarkably thin layer in the lung model.
examples.zh: 图谱把肺模型中的「单层鳞状上皮」画成很薄的一层。

examples.en: We recognized simple squamous epithelium by the single row of flat cells in section.
examples.zh: 我们根据切面上单排扁平细胞辨认出了「单层鳞状上皮」。

words.enDefinition: Single layer of epithelial cells roughly equal in height and width

examples.en: The simple cuboidal epithelium forms a single ring around the opening in our drawing.
examples.zh: 在图中，「单层立方上皮」围绕开口形成单独的一圈。

examples.en: We labeled simple cuboidal epithelium around a small tubule on the textbook illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在教材插图中的一段小管周围标出了「单层立方上皮」。

words.enDefinition: Single epithelial layer with cells taller than they are wide

examples.en: In the intestine drawing, simple columnar epithelium appears as a single row of tall cells.
examples.zh: 在肠道示意图中，「单层柱状上皮」呈现为一排高细胞。

examples.en: We identified the simple columnar epithelium by looking for one continuous layer of columns.
examples.zh: 我们根据一层连续的柱形细胞辨认出了「单层柱状上皮」。

words.enDefinition: Multilayered epithelium with flattened cells at its exposed surface

examples.en: The stratified squamous epithelium has several layers, and the cells become flatter near the top.
examples.zh: 「复层鳞状上皮」有多层细胞，细胞越靠近表面越扁平。

examples.en: We recognized stratified squamous epithelium by its multiple layers and flattened surface cells.
examples.zh: 我们根据多层结构和扁平的表层细胞辨认出了「复层鳞状上皮」。

words.enDefinition: Single epithelial layer appearing multilayered because its nuclei lie at different heights

examples.en: The nuclei appear at different heights in the drawing of pseudostratified columnar epithelium.
examples.zh: 在「假复层柱状上皮」图中，细胞核位于不同的高度。

examples.en: We checked that every cell in the pseudostratified columnar epithelium touched the basement membrane.
examples.zh: 我们确认了「假复层柱状上皮」中的每个细胞都接触基底膜。

words.enDefinition: Layered lining of parts of the urinary tract that changes shape when stretched

examples.en: The atlas shows transitional epithelium lining a simplified model of the urinary bladder.
examples.zh: 图谱把「移行上皮」画在简化膀胱模型的内表面。

examples.en: The surface cells of transitional epithelium look flatter in the stretched model.
examples.zh: 在拉伸状态模型中，「移行上皮」的表层细胞看起来更扁平。

words.enDefinition: Multilayered epithelial covering with a flattened, keratin-rich outermost layer

examples.en: The skin diagram shows keratinized stratified squamous epithelium at the body's outermost boundary.
examples.zh: 皮肤示意图把「角化复层鳞状上皮」画在人体最外侧边界。

examples.en: We labeled the dry surface layer of keratinized stratified squamous epithelium in the textbook drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在教材图中标出了「角化复层鳞状上皮」的干燥表层。

layers of keratinized stratified squamous epithelium

words.enDefinition: Multilayered epithelium whose flattened surface cells retain nuclei and lack keratinization

examples.en: The atlas labels the lining of the esophagus as nonkeratinized stratified squamous epithelium.
examples.zh: 图谱将食管内衬标注为「非角化复层鳞状上皮」。

examples.en: Surface cells in the drawing of nonkeratinized stratified squamous epithelium still contain visible nuclei.
examples.zh: 「非角化复层鳞状上皮」的图中，表层细胞仍有可见的细胞核。

collocations: lining of nonkeratinized stratified squamous epithelium
surface of nonkeratinized stratified squamous epithelium

words.enDefinition: Epithelial tissue bearing tiny hairlike cilia on its exposed cell surfaces

examples.en: In the illustration, tiny projections line the upper edge of the ciliated epithelium.
examples.zh: 图中「纤毛上皮」的上缘有一排细小突起。

examples.en: We looked for a fringe on the exposed side to recognize the ciliated epithelium.
examples.zh: 我们观察朝外的一侧是否有细缘，以辨认「纤毛上皮」。

words.enDefinition: Epithelial tissue specialized to produce and release substances from gland cells

examples.en: The diagram groups cells of glandular epithelium into clusters around a small space.
examples.zh: 示意图将「腺上皮」细胞画成围绕一个小腔的细胞簇。

examples.en: In the gland drawing, we labeled the cell clusters as glandular epithelium.
examples.zh: 我们在腺体图中将这些细胞簇标为「腺上皮」。

words.enDefinition: Lining of passages opening to the exterior, consisting of epithelium and connective tissue

examples.en: The mucous membrane diagram shows a surface layer attached to supporting tissue below.
examples.zh: 「黏膜」示意图展示一个表层与下方支撑组织相连。

examples.en: We identified a mucous membrane on the inner surface of the digestive tract model.
examples.zh: 我们在消化道模型内表面辨认出了「黏膜」。

words.enDefinition: Body covering consisting of an outer epithelial layer and underlying connective tissue

examples.en: The cutaneous membrane covers the outward surface of the full body model.
examples.zh: 「皮肤膜」覆盖全身模型的外表面。

examples.en: We identified both layers of the cutaneous membrane in a simplified skin diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在简化皮肤图中辨认了「皮肤膜」的两层结构。

words.enDefinition: Connective tissue layer lying directly beneath the epithelium of a mucous membrane

examples.en: The lamina propria lies beneath the band of epithelial cells in the diagram.
examples.zh: 在图中，「固有层」位于带状上皮细胞的下方。

examples.en: We shaded the lamina propria to show where the supporting connective tissue begins.
examples.zh: 我们给「固有层」加上阴影，以显示支撑性结缔组织从哪里开始。

words.enDefinition: Network of material outside cells that gives a tissue structural support

examples.en: The connective tissue diagram shows the extracellular matrix filling the spaces between cells.
examples.zh: 结缔组织示意图显示「细胞外基质」填在细胞之间。

examples.en: We labeled the visible fibers as part of the extracellular matrix in the image.
examples.zh: 我们将图中可见的纤维标为「细胞外基质」的一部分。

words.enDefinition: Nonfibrous material of connective tissue matrix that surrounds its cells and fibers

examples.en: The diagram shows ground substance between the colored fibers of the supporting tissue.
examples.zh: 图中带颜色的支撑组织纤维之间显示的是「无定形基质」。

examples.en: We distinguished ground substance from the longer fibers in the textbook image.
examples.zh: 我们把教材图中的「无定形基质」与较长的纤维区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Bundles of collagen that help tissues resist stretching forces

examples.en: The atlas shows thick bundles of collagen fibers running in one main direction.
examples.zh: 图谱显示粗大的「胶原纤维」束沿同一主要方向延伸。

examples.en: We labeled the long bundles of collagen fibers in a simplified tendon image.
examples.zh: 我们在简化的肌腱图中标出了长长的「胶原纤维」束。

words.enDefinition: Connective tissue strands allowing tissues to stretch and return toward their original shape

examples.en: The textbook shows elastic fibers as thin strands branching across the connective tissue diagram.
examples.zh: 教材在结缔组织图中将「弹性纤维」画成有分支的细丝。

examples.en: We discussed how elastic fibers help a stretched tissue return toward its original shape.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「弹性纤维」如何帮助被拉伸的组织恢复原来的形状。

words.enDefinition: Thin connective tissue strands that form a supporting mesh around cells

examples.en: The model shows reticular fibers forming a fine network around the illustrated cells.
examples.zh: 模型显示「网状纤维」在图示细胞周围形成细密网络。

examples.en: We labeled the delicate mesh of reticular fibers in the supporting tissue drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在支撑组织图中标出了细密的「网状纤维」网。

words.enDefinition: Connective tissue with relatively few loosely arranged fibers and abundant ground substance

examples.en: The diagram shows loose connective tissue with visible spaces between the loosely arranged fibers.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「疏松结缔组织」排列疏松的纤维之间有可见间隙。

examples.en: We marked loose connective tissue underneath the surface layer of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型表层的下方标出了「疏松结缔组织」。

words.enDefinition: Connective tissue in which closely arranged fibers make up much of the matrix

examples.en: The dense connective tissue appears as thick bundles that fill most of the view.
examples.zh: 「致密结缔组织」呈现为充满视野大部分区域的粗纤维束。

examples.en: We recognized dense connective tissue by the abundance of fibers in the enlarged diagram.
examples.zh: 我们根据放大图中大量的纤维识别出「致密结缔组织」。

words.enDefinition: Common loose connective tissue containing scattered cells and several loosely arranged fiber types

examples.en: The diagram labels areolar connective tissue beneath the epithelial surface in the teaching model.
examples.zh: 图中在教学模型的上皮表面下方标注了「蜂窝状结缔组织」。

examples.en: We located scattered cells among the fibers of areolar connective tissue in the enlarged image.
examples.zh: 我们在放大图中找到了散布于「蜂窝状结缔组织」纤维之间的细胞。

words.enDefinition: Connective tissue with tightly packed collagen bundles aligned in one main direction

examples.en: The tendon model shows dense regular connective tissue with long bundles lined up in parallel.
examples.zh: 肌腱模型中的「致密规则结缔组织」由平行排列的长纤维束组成。

examples.en: We identified dense regular connective tissue by the matching direction of most fibers in the image.
examples.zh: 图中多数纤维的走向相同，据此我们辨认出「致密规则结缔组织」。

diagram of dense regular connective tissue

words.enDefinition: Connective tissue with tightly packed collagen bundles oriented in several directions

examples.en: The dermis diagram labels dense irregular connective tissue where the collagen bundles cross in several directions.
examples.zh: 真皮示意图把胶原纤维束朝多个方向交错的部分标为「致密不规则结缔组织」。

examples.en: We recognized dense irregular connective tissue from its many differently oriented bundles in the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们根据图谱中朝向各异的多束纤维辨认出了「致密不规则结缔组织」。

collocations: fibers of dense irregular connective tissue
diagram of dense irregular connective tissue

words.enDefinition: Connective tissue rich in cells storing fat, often used for insulation

examples.en: The cutaway model shows a layer of adipose tissue beneath the skin.
examples.zh: 剖切模型展示了皮肤下方的一层「脂肪组织」。

examples.en: We marked the large rounded cells of adipose tissue in the atlas figure.
examples.zh: 我们在图谱上标出了「脂肪组织」中的大型圆形细胞。

words.enDefinition: Muscle composed of long striated fibers involved in voluntary body movement

examples.en: The skeletal muscle tissue image shows long parallel fibers with visible bands across them.
examples.zh: 「骨骼肌组织」图像呈现出平行排列的长纤维，横向有清晰条纹。

examples.en: We labeled skeletal muscle tissue in the region attached to the model's bone.
examples.zh: 我们在与模型骨相连的部位标出了「骨骼肌组织」。

words.enDefinition: Striated muscle of the heart composed of branching cells that contract together

examples.en: The diagram highlights branching fibers within the model of cardiac muscle tissue.
examples.zh: 示意图在「心肌组织」模型中突出显示了分支纤维。

examples.en: We compared cardiac muscle tissue with the long parallel fibers of the skeletal example.
examples.zh: 我们将「心肌组织」与骨骼肌示例中平行的长纤维作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Muscle without visible striations that forms parts of hollow organ walls

examples.en: The gut wall model marks a layer of smooth muscle tissue beneath the lining.
examples.zh: 肠壁模型在内衬下方标出一层「平滑肌组织」。

examples.en: We recognized smooth muscle tissue from the narrow cells lacking obvious bands in the illustration.
examples.zh: 图中细长的细胞没有明显条纹，据此我们辨认出了「平滑肌组织」。

words.enDefinition: Thin slice of tissue shown for examination of its microscopic structure

examples.en: The histological section reveals the boundary between the surface layer and supporting tissue.
examples.zh: 「组织学切片」显示出表层与支撑组织之间的边界。

examples.en: We labeled two tissue types on the histological section reproduced in the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们在图谱复制的「组织学切片」上标出了两种组织类型。

collocations: tissue types in a histological section

words.enDefinition: Regulation that keeps important internal conditions within a workable range

examples.en: The model illustrates homeostasis by keeping an internal variable within a narrow range.
examples.zh: 模型通过使一个内部变量保持在较窄范围内说明「稳态」。

examples.en: We compared the graph illustrating homeostasis with the curve for an unregulated system.
examples.zh: 我们将说明「稳态」的图与无调节系统的曲线作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Bodily condition monitored and adjusted by a regulatory system

examples.en: We marked temperature as the regulated physiological variable on our classroom feedback diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂反馈图上将温度标为「受调节的生理变量」。

examples.en: The line for the regulated physiological variable stays near the model's target over time.
examples.zh: 表示「受调节的生理变量」的曲线随时间保持在模型目标附近。

collocations: change in a regulated physiological variable

words.enDefinition: A reference value or level around which a physiological control system regulates a variable.

examples.en: The graph uses a dashed line to mark the homeostatic set point.
examples.zh: 图中用虚线标出了「稳态设定点」。

examples.en: We observed small fluctuations around the homeostatic set point in our simulated trace.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟曲线中观察到围绕「稳态设定点」的轻微波动。

collocations: regulate around a homeostatic set point
change in the homeostatic set point

words.enDefinition: Interval within which a physiological variable commonly varies under the stated conditions

examples.en: The chart shows a shaded band representing the normal physiological range for its internal variable.
examples.zh: 图中用阴影带表示该内部变量的「正常生理范围」。

examples.en: We compared simulated fluctuations within the normal physiological range on two different graphs.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两张图中「正常生理范围」以内的模拟波动。

collocations: remain within the normal physiological range

words.enDefinition: Regulatory sequence that detects changes and produces responses tending to restore internal conditions

examples.en: The homeostatic feedback loop diagram follows information from the monitored variable to the response.
examples.zh: 「稳态反馈回路」示意图展示信息如何从被监测变量传到响应环节。

examples.en: We used arrows to show how the homeostatic feedback loop counteracts the original change.
examples.zh: 我们用箭头表示「稳态反馈回路」怎样抵消最初的变化。

collocations: parts of a homeostatic feedback loop

words.enDefinition: Structure that detects changes in a bodily condition and conveys that information

examples.en: The diagram shows a physiological sensor detecting a change in the monitored variable.
examples.zh: 示意图显示一个「生理感受器」正在感知被监测变量的变化。

examples.en: We labeled the physiological sensor at the beginning of the classroom feedback loop.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂反馈回路的起始处标出了「生理感受器」。

words.enDefinition: Component of a regulatory system that processes incoming information and directs a response

examples.en: The homeostatic control center receives information before sending an output in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中的「稳态调节中枢」先接收信息，再发出输出信号。

examples.en: We drew an arrow toward the homeostatic control center from the detector symbol.
examples.zh: 我们从表示感受器的符号向「稳态调节中枢」画了一个箭头。

collocations: signal to a homeostatic control center
function of the homeostatic control center

words.enDefinition: Structure that carries out a response to a signal from a control system

examples.en: The diagram shows the physiological effector carrying out the response indicated by an arrow.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「生理效应器」执行由箭头标明的响应。

examples.en: We labeled a muscle on the model as the physiological effector in this example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，我们把模型上的一块肌肉标为「生理效应器」。

words.enDefinition: Part of the body distinguished by where its water and solutes reside

examples.en: We gave each body fluid compartment a different color in our distribution diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在体液分布图中给每个「体液区室」分配了不同颜色。

examples.en: The model places a cell membrane along one body fluid compartment boundary.
examples.zh: 模型将细胞膜画成其中一个「体液区室」的边界。

collocations: volume of a body fluid compartment

words.enDefinition: Water and dissolved substances contained inside the body's cells

examples.en: The classroom figure shades intracellular fluid inside the boundary of each illustrated cell.
examples.zh: 课堂图在各图示细胞的边界以内用阴影表示「细胞内液」。

examples.en: We labeled intracellular fluid on the inner side of the cell membrane.
examples.zh: 我们在细胞膜内侧标出了「细胞内液」。

words.enDefinition: Water and dissolved substances occupying the body spaces outside its cells

examples.en: The chart groups the fluid outside cells as extracellular fluid in the model.
examples.zh: 图表将模型中细胞外的液体统一归作「细胞外液」。

examples.en: We divided extracellular fluid into several smaller regions on the teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在教学示意图上将「细胞外液」划分为若干较小的区域。

words.enDefinition: Portion of extracellular fluid occupying the spaces between tissue cells

examples.en: The diagram shows interstitial fluid in the spaces among the colored tissue cells.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「组织间液」位于彩色组织细胞之间的空隙中。

examples.en: We colored interstitial fluid differently from the fluid inside the drawn blood vessel.
examples.zh: 我们给「组织间液」与所画血管内部的液体用了不同的颜色。

words.enDefinition: Specialized portion of extracellular fluid separated from other compartments by tissue boundaries

examples.en: The chart lists fluid in joint cavities as an example of transcellular fluid.
examples.zh: 图表把关节腔内的液体列为「跨细胞液」的例子。

examples.en: We marked transcellular fluid in the small specialized spaces on the model diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在模型图的小型专门腔隙里标出了「跨细胞液」。

words.enDefinition: The relationship between the body's water intake and water loss over a period, determining whether its total water content rises, falls or remains steady.

examples.en: Our classroom model shows fluid balance when total inflow equals total outflow.
examples.zh: 课堂模型显示，流入总量等于流出总量时达到「体液平衡」。

examples.en: We plotted the two totals separately before discussing fluid balance in the simulation.
examples.zh: 我们分别画出两个总量，再讨论仿真中的「体液平衡」。
